engine.name: typesense
engine.keyword_setup: Not BM25; the harness creates the text field with locale `en` and `stem` enabled, applies the Lucene English stop words the BM25 engines analyze with, sets `drop_tokens_threshold` to the number of results requested so a long question drops words until that many documents match, sorts by `_text_match`, and leaves every other setting at its default
